title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.


About the role:

As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional SME Trading Infrastructure. You will work closely with Götz Röhr, Pim Hannay and the Brokerage Product & Engineering Leadership team. In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial teams, driving topics critical to Upvest's success.

What you can expect from this role:

  • Impact and influence, laying the foundations on how one of Europe's leading infrastructure companies builds their trading infrastructure.

  • Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You run your topics and are trusted to drive them to results.

title: Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
description:
Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

Adventure Ahead 🚀

Step into a high-impact role as a Senior Account Executive for Enterprise Sales in DACH, where you will drive strategic growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You’ll partner with major enterprises to transform how they approach learning, enablement, and skills development—turning complex business priorities into measurable, real-world outcomes. Working alongside a powerhouse team of Solutions Consultants, BDRs, and executive leaders, you’ll own the full customer journey from bold territory strategy to celebratory contract close, directly shaping Docebo’s footprint in one of Europe’s most dynamic markets.

The Day-to-Day 💻

  • Command Your Territory: Own and expand a portfolio of named and strategic enterprise accounts across DACH, smashing ARR, pipeline-generation, and new-business targets through sharp account planning and whitespace mapping.

  • Orchestrate Winning Deals: Lead complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from initial discovery to signed agreement, mobilizing BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Legal, Security, Value Engineering, and partners to deliver seamless evaluations and RFPs.

  • Champion Buyer-Centric Selling: Guide buying committees—from HR and L&D to IT, Finance, and C-suite economic buyers—through Docebo’s buyer-centric sales stages and MEDDPICC qualification, building internal consensus around clear, evidence-based milestones.

  • Quantify Real Business Impact: Run high-impact discovery sessions to uncover core business drivers and the cost of inaction, crafting executive-ready ROI narratives and defensible business cases that withstand Finance-level scrutiny.

  • Translate Learning into Capability: Connect Docebo’s Learning Suite (LMS, LXP, content, analytics, and skills frameworks) to critical enterprise initiatives like onboarding, compliance, sales enablement, and workforce upskilling.

  • Drive Predictable Execution: Maintain inspection-ready forecasting and deal hygiene in Salesforce and Gong while partnering with RevOps and regional leadership to refine repeatable enterprise plays and represent Docebo at key DACH industry events.


Your Superpowers 🦸‍♀️

  • 7+ years of proven success closing complex B2B SaaS enterprise new-business deals, consistently exceeding quotas and building pipeline in named or strategic territories.

  • Deep mastery of value-based selling, executive business-case creation, commercial negotiation, and structured qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC.

  • Natural ability to map intricate buying committees, cultivate internal champions, engage C-level economic buyers, and align cross-functional internal teams without overpromising.

  • Strong command of enterprise LMS/LXP platforms or adjacent HR tech (HCM, HRIS, talent, or enablement), paired with a working knowledge of skills-based talent development.

  • Sharp analytical and forecasting habits using Salesforce, Gong, and modern prospecting tools, backed by the strategic judgment to qualify out poor-fit opportunities early.

  • Fluency in English and German

  • Ability to travel regularly across DACH and to selected EMEA customer meetings or events (approximately 20–30%).


Bonus Points 🌟

  • Direct experience selling enterprise learning, LMS/LXP, HR Tech, or workforce-development solutions, ideally backed by existing relationships with DACH HR, L&D, Talent, or IT leaders.

  • Hands-on familiarity with global learning programs serving external audiences (customers and partners), as well as complex enterprise security reviews, integrations, and RFP-led evaluations.

  • Background thriving in an international, remote-first SaaS environment with a track record of coaching and elevating fellow sellers.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People:

  • Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success.

  • Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

 

Our Promise to You 😍

  • Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package.

  • Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it.

  • Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off!

  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

 

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world.

title: Growth Manager / Senior Growth Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Portfolio, Wachstums-Roadmap und Go-to-Market für Cloud-, Daten-, KI- und SaaS-Lösungen – du machst Marketing und Vertrieb im deutschsprachigen Mittelstand noch erfolgreicher.

Über Coduct Group

Die Coduct-Gruppe verbindet Technologieberatung, Umsetzung und eigene Produkte unter einem Dach. Seit 2017 begleiten wir Unternehmen bei der Modernisierung ihrer IT-Systeme, Plattformen und Cloud-Architekturen – von der Analyse über Entwicklung und Migration bis zum Betrieb.

  • Die Marke Coduct (Kamp-Lintfort, Berlin, Ho-Chi-Minh-City): IT-Beratung und Softwareentwicklung für Cloud, Daten, KI und Automatisierung; auch als Build-Operate-Transfer-Modell (BOT)

  • Die Marke ainavio: unsere SaaS-Plattform für Produktinformationsmanagement (PIM)

  • Die Marke Code Leap: unsere Software-Engineering-Marke

Als Microsoft CSP-Partner und dreifach zertifizierter Microsoft Solutions Partner (Data & AI, Digital & App Innovation, Infrastructure/Azure) kombinieren wir Lizenzierung, Beratung und Umsetzung aus einer Hand. Zu unseren Kunden gehören Energieversorger, ERP- und Softwareanbieter, Handel und E-Commerce sowie Industrieunternehmen – darunter JTL, Netze BW, Schleupen und Galeria.

Warum wir diese Rolle jetzt besetzen

Wir stehen an der Schwelle zur nächsten Wachstumsphase. Dafür haben wir die Unternehmensfunktion Growth geschaffen, geführt von unserem VP Growth. Growth plant das Wachstum der Gruppe und sorgt dafür, dass es gelingt: Wir entwickeln Portfolio und Wachstums-Roadmap und befähigen Marketing und Vertrieb, Wachstum zu realisieren.

Wichtig: Growth ist kein zweiter Vertrieb – aber Growth jagt. Nach dem Hunting-Prinzip spürst du Wachstumschancen aktiv auf und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss. Kundenbeziehungen liegen beim Vertrieb; du sorgst dafür, dass er die richtigen Angebote, Argumente und Werkzeuge hat – und dass aus ersten Aufträgen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen werden.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Wachstumsstrategie & Growth-Roadmap

  • Du entwickelst mit dem VP Growth eine mehrjährige Growth-Roadmap mit klaren Etappen, Prioritäten und Meilensteinen

  • Du jagst aktiv Wachstumschancen – neue Segmente, Partnerschaften (u. a. Microsoft), Großchancen bei Neu- und Bestandskunden – und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zum Abschluss

  • Du bewertest Zielsegmente und validierst neue Geschäftsfelder schnell und pragmatisch

  • Du übersetzt die Roadmap in konkrete Initiativen, Business Cases und gemeinsame Ziele mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Delivery

2. Portfolio-Entwicklung (Kern der Rolle)

  • Du gestaltest unsere Portfolio-Architektur mit einer ausgewogenen Balance aus Volumen- bzw. Standardangeboten (z. B. CSP, Managed Services, SaaS, Festpreis-Pakete) und Premium- bzw. Individualleistungen (z. B. Beratung, Custom Development, BOT, End-to-End-Transformation)

  • Du produktisierst wiederkehrende Projektmuster zu skalierbaren Angeboten – und schärfst gleichzeitig die Differenzierung unserer Premiumleistungen

  • Du verantwortest Positionierung (Problem – Lösung – Nutzen), Pricing-Logik und Lifecycle der Angebote, gemeinsam mit Delivery und Technologie

3. Land-and-Expand-Modell

  • Du entwickelst Einstiegsangebote, mit denen neue Kunden einfach starten können (Land), und klare Ausbaupfade hin zu Folgeprojekten, Managed Services, Lizenzen und SaaS (Expand)

  • Du baust Programme für die Entwicklung unserer Bestandskunden auf – z. B. vom reinen Lizenzbezug zu Cloud-, Daten- und KI-Services – und gibst dem Vertrieb dafür Anlässe, Zielkundenlisten und Werkzeuge an die Hand

4. Enablement von Marketing & Vertrieb

  • Du befähigst den Vertrieb mit Playbooks, Pitch- und Angebotsvorlagen, Argumentationshilfen, Pricing-Rechnern und Schulungen

  • Du entwickelst mit Marketing Zielgruppen, Ideal Customer Profiles, Messaging und Kampagnen und sorgst für eine konsistente Story: Was machen wir, für wen, und warum Coduct?

  • Du unterstützt bei strategisch wichtigen Angeboten mit Angebotsstruktur und Pricing – die Kundenverantwortung bleibt beim Vertrieb

5. Growth-Prozesse & Steuerung

  • Du gestaltest das Growth Operating Model: Prozesse und Übergaben von Marketing über Vertrieb bis Delivery, klare Rollen und CRM-Standards

  • Du baust ein KPI-System auf – von Pipeline und Conversion über Expansion-Umsatz und Net Revenue Retention bis zum Anteil standardisierter und wiederkehrender Umsätze und zum Margen-Mix

  • Du steuerst Initiativen datenbasiert und machst Learnings teamübergreifend nutzbar

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

  • Umsatzbeitrag neuer und überarbeiteter Angebote

  • Expansion bei Bestandskunden (z. B. Cross-Sell-Quote, Net Revenue Retention)

  • Ausgewogener Portfolio-Mix: Anteil standardisierter/wiederkehrender Umsätze bei gesunder Marge im Premiumgeschäft

  • Wirksamkeit des Enablements: Nutzung durch den Vertrieb, Conversion und Time-to-Sale neuer Angebote

  • Umsetzung der Growth-Roadmap nach Plan

Diese Ziele bilden – zusammen mit der Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT der Gruppe – die Grundlage deiner variablen Vergütung.

Was du mitbringst

Erfahrung & Know-how

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre im B2B-Umfeld in Portfolio- oder Produktmanagement, Growth, Strategie, Go-to-Market oder Business Development – idealerweise in IT-Services, Cloud, Software oder Beratung

  • Portfolio-Management: Du hast Angebote entwickelt, produktisiert, bepreist und erfolgreich in den Markt gebracht

  • Land and Expand: Du hast Einstiegsangebote und Ausbaupfade gestaltet und kennst die Hebel für Wachstum im Bestand

  • Balance von Volumen und Premium: Du verstehst, wie sich Standard- und Individualgeschäft in Preis, Marge, Delivery und Vertrieb unterscheiden – und wie beide sich verstärken

  • Strategische Kompetenz: Du entwickelst Roadmaps, setzt Prioritäten und übersetzt Strategie in messbare Ergebnisse

  • Vertriebserfahrung: Du kennst Vertrieb aus eigener Praxis (z. B. Vertrieb, Pre-Sales, Key Account) und weißt, was Vertriebsteams wirklich hilft

  • Mittelstand, DACH, SaaS und CSP: Du kennst Bedürfnisse und Entscheidungswege mittelständischer Unternehmen, den DACH-Markt sowie SaaS- und Microsoft-CSP-Geschäftsmodelle

  • Prozessmanagement & Vertriebscontrolling: Du gestaltest Prozesse über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg, arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPIs

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und fließendes Englisch

Persönlichkeit & Arbeitsweise

  • Hunter-Mentalität: Du jagst neue Wachstumschancen – Segmente, Partnerschaften, Großchancen – und bringst sie mit Marketing und Vertrieb zum Abschluss

  • Ergebnisorientierung: Du willst dich an messbaren Zielen und an deiner Wirkung auf Umsatz und EBIT messen lassen – auch in der Vergütung

  • Macher:in: Du handelst proaktiv, mit Bias for Action, und lieferst Ergebnisse statt Konzepte für die Schublade

  • Einfluss ohne Weisungsbefugnis: Du überzeugst Vertrieb, Marketing, Delivery und Geschäftsführung – mit Klarheit, Daten und guten Argumenten

  • Teamplayer in verteilten Teams: Du machst andere erfolgreich, teilst Wissen offen und arbeitest gern remote, asynchron und mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Vietnam

  • Ambition zu wachsen: Du willst in den nächsten Jahren mehr strategische und Führungsverantwortung übernehmen

Wünschenswert

  • Erfahrung im Microsoft-Partner-Ökosystem (Co-Selling, Partnerprogramme, Marketplace)

  • Erfahrung mit Sales- oder Revenue-Operations und Enablement-Programmen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools in Analyse, Content und Enablement

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust die Growth-Funktion von Anfang an mit auf und arbeitest direkt mit VP Growth und Geschäftsführung zusammen

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung: Fixgehalt plus variable Komponente – dein Erfolg bei Growth-KPIs, Umsatz und EBIT zahlt sich direkt aus

  • Entwicklungspfad: Die Rolle ist bewusst als Sprungbrett angelegt – hin zu einer führenden Growth-Rolle in der Gruppe

  • Zukunftsthemen: Cloud, Daten, KI und eigene SaaS-Produkte – mit eigenem Delivery-Center in Vietnam

  • Kultur: ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, ehrlich kommuniziert, pragmatisch entscheidet und kurze Wege hat

  • Flexibilität: flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten – Office Kamp-Lintfort oder Berlin (ca. 1 Tag/Woche), sonst mobil innerhalb Deutschlands; gelegentliche Reisen in der DACH-Region

So läuft der Auswahlprozess

  • Sichtung deiner Unterlagen – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 10 Werktagen

  • Erstgespräch (ca. 75 Minuten, per Video) mit VP Growth, Chief of Staff und einem Teammitglied aus Vertrieb oder Marketing

  • Fallstudie und Zweitgespräch (ca. 90 Min., per Video) mit der Geschäftsführung – du präsentierst deine Lösung einer praxisnahen Aufgabe (ca. 1 Woche Vorbereitung)

  • Angebot

Interesse?

Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und beantworte uns kurz eine Frage: Welches Angebot hast du zuletzt so entwickelt oder geschärft, dass es spürbar mehr Umsatz gebracht hat – und wie hast du den Vertrieb dabei mitgenommen? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestmöglichen Starttermin nennst du uns gern direkt mit.

Bei uns findest du ein Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam seine Ziele verfolgt. Wir setzen auf ehrliche Kommunikation, pragmatische Lösungen und eine Atmosphäre, in der Arbeiten Freude macht. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft innovativer Projekte!

title: Marketing Project Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Project Management meets Hands-on Marketing & AI

Ein neues Kundenprojekt kommt rein. Unterschiedliche Anforderungen, neue Herausforderungen, viele Möglichkeiten.

Während andere erst einmal überlegen, wer sich darum kümmern könnte, denkst du schon: „Spannend. Ich übernehme das. Let's go!“

Du verstehst, was der Kunde braucht, entwickelst passende Lösungen, kalkulierst ein Angebot und bringst das Projekt auf den Weg. Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten, packst selbst mit an und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer Idee ein richtig gutes Ergebnis wird.

Dabei ist KI für dich nicht einfach ein nettes Extra. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, baust dir eigene Workflows und hast den Anspruch, dich in neue Tools schnell einzuarbeiten und sie wirklich auszureizen.

Ob Kampagne, Website oder Content: Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können. Aber du weißt, wie du die richtigen Menschen, Ideen und Technologien zusammenbringst.

Du bist nicht nur dabei. Du übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst mit und machst Dinge möglich.

Was du bei uns machst

Du übernimmst abwechslungsreiche Marketingprojekte von A bis Z – von der ersten Anfrage bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Du übernimmst Ownership. Du machst Kundenprojekte zu deinen eigenen, führst sie eigenständig von Briefing und Konzeption bis zur finalen Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass alles läuft.

  • Du berätst und entwickelst Lösungen. Du verstehst die Ziele deiner Kunden, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst passende Konzepte und Maßnahmen.

  • Du kalkulierst und planst. Du erstellst Angebote, schätzt Aufwände ein, planst Ressourcen und behältst Budgets, Timings und Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick.

  • Du packst selbst mit an. Ob Konzepte, Präsentationen, Texte, Briefings oder andere Marketing-Deliverables: Du setzt Aufgaben auch selbst um, statt ausschließlich zu delegieren.

  • Du nutzt KI und entwickelst neue Workflows. Mit Tools wie ChatGPT und Claude optimierst du deine Arbeit, automatisierst Prozesse und probierst neue Wege aus, von denen auch das Team profitiert.

  • Du koordinierst alle Beteiligten. Du steuerst interne Teams, Kreative, Entwickler und externe Dienstleister und sorgst für klare Briefings und gute Ergebnisse.

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden. Du führst Meetings, präsentierst Ergebnisse, steuerst Erwartungen und sorgst für eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit.

Dich erwartet ein bunter Mix aus Kunden, Branchen und Marketingdisziplinen. Langfristig kannst du je nach deinen Stärken und Interessen auch eigene Schwerpunkte entwickeln.

KI ist für uns kein Buzzword

Wir gehören zu den Agenturen, die KI-Tools gezielt, geplant und mit echtem Mehrwert einsetzen – nicht als Experiment, sondern im Arbeitsalltag. Darauf sind wir stolz, und genau das bauen wir weiter aus.

Schon heute nutzen wir eigene KI-Workflows, zum Beispiel für Projektsteuerung, Konzepte, Umsetzung und interne Prozesse.

Du musst dafür kein Entwickler oder Automatisierungsexperte sein. Aber du solltest KI-Tools sicher beherrschen und Lust haben, unsere Workflows weiterzuentwickeln und neue zu bauen, von denen das ganze Team und unsere Kunden profitieren.

Dafür bekommst du bei uns die Tools, den Freiraum und die Zeit.

Was diese Stelle NICHT ist

Kein reines Projektmanagement. Wenn du am liebsten ausschließlich Aufgaben verteilst, Timelines aktualisierst und Statusmeetings organisierst, wirst du bei uns nicht glücklich. Du sollst Projekte auch inhaltlich voranbringen.

Keine reine Kundenberatung. Wir suchen niemanden, der Konzepte entwickelt und die Umsetzung dann vollständig an andere übergibt. Bei uns bleibst du dran, bis das Ergebnis steht.

Keine reine operative Marketingrolle. Du arbeitest nicht einfach nur Briefings ab, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung für das große Ganze und steuerst die Umsetzung.

Keine Spezialistenrolle für nur eine Marketingdisziplin. Du musst nicht alles perfekt beherrschen, solltest aber Lust auf unterschiedliche Marketingthemen und neue Herausforderungen haben.

Und definitiv keine Rolle, in der KI nur bedeutet, gelegentlich ChatGPT nach einem Text zu fragen. Wir suchen jemanden, der neue Möglichkeiten aktiv erkundet und eigene Ideen entwickelt.

Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen keinen reinen Verwalter, Berater oder Umsetzer. Sondern jemanden, der all das sinnvoll miteinander verbindet.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast idealerweise 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing, vorzugsweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast bereits eigenständig Kundenprojekte betreut.

  • Du bringst ein breites Marketingverständnis mit und kannst dich schnell in neue Themen, Branchen und Aufgabenstellungen einarbeiten.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Angebotserstellung, Aufwandsschätzung und Budgetsteuerung und verstehst die wirtschaftliche Seite von Projekten.

  • Du bist organisatorisch, konzeptionell und operativ stark, kommunizierst souverän mit Kunden und kannst Ergebnisse fachlich beurteilen.

  • KI ist fester Teil deiner Arbeitsweise. Du arbeitest souverän mit Tools wie Claude, Claude Code oder ChatGPT, hast bereits eigene KI-Workflows aufgebaut oder Arbeitsabläufe damit spürbar verbessert und kannst uns konkret zeigen, wie.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und pragmatisch, findest Lösungen statt Probleme weiterzugeben und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.

  • Du hast Spaß an Abwechslung, denkst über deinen eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus und möchtest dich fachlich und technologisch weiterentwickeln.

Was uns wichtiger ist als ein perfekter Lebenslauf: Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marketing, denkst mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Dinge zuverlässig ins Ziel. Und du hast richtig Lust darauf, gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, wie modernes Marketing mit KI noch besser funktionieren kann.

Warum Effecticore?

Weil gute Arbeit Spaß machen darf. Und das Leben neben der Arbeit genauso wichtig ist.

Wir verbringen einen großen Teil unserer Zeit miteinander. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass wir nicht nur gut zusammenarbeiten, sondern auch menschlich auf einer Wellenlänge sind. Wir mögen unkomplizierte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege, gegenseitige Unterstützung und eine ordentliche Portion Humor.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird. Zwei bis drei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind bei uns ganz normal. Wann du sie nutzt, stimmen wir flexibel miteinander ab. Auch private Termine zwischendurch oder kurzfristiger Urlaub sind kein Problem. Unsere üblichen Arbeitszeiten liegen ungefähr zwischen 9 und 18 Uhr – mit genügend Spielraum für das echte Leben.

  • Verantwortung und Freiraum. Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen, kannst eigene Entscheidungen treffen und Projekte und Prozesse aktiv mitgestalten.

  • Raum für KI und neue Ideen. Du bekommst Zugang zu professionellen KI-Tools und die Freiheit, damit zu experimentieren, neue Workflows zu entwickeln und Prozesse zu optimieren – ausdrücklich während deiner Arbeitszeit.

  • Ein Team, in dem die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, kommunizieren auf Augenhöhe und lachen viel. Freiwillige Teamabende und gemeinsame Aktionen gehören auch dazu.

  • Workation in Kroatien. Einmal im Jahr tauschen wir unser Büro gegen eine Villa in Kroatien und verbringen dort eine gemeinsame Woche mit Arbeiten, Sonne und Teamzeit.

  • Weiterentwicklung, die zu dir passt. Wir unterstützen individuelle Fortbildungen und geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen und neue Themen für dich zu entdecken.

  • Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen. Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, hochwertige Ausstattung, gute Erreichbarkeit, kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und Snacks. Und auch Hunde sind bei uns willkommen.

  • Wellpass für deine Gesundheit. Ob Gym, Yoga, Schwimmen oder Wellness – mit Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, auch außerhalb der Arbeit etwas für dich zu tun.

Und vielleicht das Wichtigste: Wir nehmen unsere Arbeit ernst, aber nicht wichtiger als alles andere.

Natürlich wollen wir für unsere Kunden richtig gute Ergebnisse erzielen. Wir sind Dienstleister, wir übernehmen Verantwortung und manchmal muss auch etwas kurzfristig möglich gemacht werden.

Aber wir glauben nicht daran, dass gute Kundenarbeit bedeutet, ständig erreichbar zu sein, regelmäßig Überstunden zu machen oder das eigene Privatleben hintenanzustellen.

Wir wollen gemeinsam erfolgreich sein, gute Arbeit leisten und dabei auch noch Spaß haben.

Denn am Ende sollen nicht nur unsere Kunden gerne mit uns arbeiten. Sondern wir auch gerne miteinander.

Klingt nach dir?

Du hast beim Lesen schon überlegt, welche Projekte du bei uns übernehmen und welche Prozesse du mit KI verbessern könntest?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Our answer is a machine-agnostic intelligence platform that lets any machine, on any site, perceive, decide, and act autonomously. One platform. Any machine. No fleet replacement.

Already live across multiple sites and customers in Europe - spanning logistics and warehousing, industrial manufacturing, and large-scale chemical production - with a US expansion underway.

The Role

A European building materials group has agreed with Hive at CEO level to roll out supervised autonomy across its quarries. Pilots are running, and the agreement covers around 80 sites in several countries over the next years.

The signed agreement is where your work starts. Head office has said yes, but every site still has to: the plant manager, the safety team and the production planner. You get each site commercially ready before our Delivery team arrives, and you decide with the customer in which order sites go live.

This role sits between Sales and Delivery. Account Executives land new customers. Delivery installs and runs the machines. You own the rollout inside the accounts that have already signed at group level, starting with this one and followed by the next global customers.

Nobody has held this job at Hive before. How you run this account becomes how Hive runs every global account after it.

What You Will Do

Own the rollout plan

  • Build the site by site rollout plan with the customer's executive sponsor.

  • Sequence the rollout against what Hive can actually deliver, and defend that sequence to the customer and internally.

  • Get each site to yes on its own numbers.

Build the business case per site

  • Set the commercial terms per site inside the frame agreement: KPI thresholds, scaling estimates, exit criteria and pricing.

  • Find the value beyond labour cost, such as pit design, shift patterns and production planning, and build the case the plant director takes to their board.

Run the relationship

  • Keep the stakeholder map current in every country, from the group executive sponsor to the site supervisor.

  • Run the governance: monthly with the customer's programme owner, quarterly with their executive sponsor, weekly with Hive's Delivery lead.

  • Hand each site over to Delivery once it is scoped, then move to the next.

Build the model

  • Carry customer requests into Product and Engineering, and push back on the ones that are not worth building.

  • Document how Hive runs a global account, and hand it to the person who takes the next one.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • You have run a multi-site or multi-country programme, either on the vendor side or as the customer's programme owner.

  • You have owned a number on an account: revenue, margin or a rollout target.

  • Experience building business cases and working with both executive teams and site operations.

  • Industrial context: construction, quarrying, mining, building materials, infrastructure or process industry.

  • Highly structured, and comfortable owning the details over a long programme.

  • You have told a customer no on scope, price or date, and kept the relationship.

  • A life situation that allows heavy travel in the UK and Europe.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Strongly Preferred

  • Operations or strategy consulting experience with industrial or infrastructure clients.

  • Experience from a large construction or building materials company.

  • French or German.

This Is Probably Not the Job for You If

  • You want to recommend and move on. Site 40 in year three is part of the job.

  • You need a delivery organisation that hits every date. Ours is young, and you will be the one explaining a slip to the customer.

  • You want a pure sales role. Landing new logos belongs to the Account Executives.

What Success Looks Like

  • The first sites are past pilot, in contract and running, and the next batch is commercially ready before Delivery gets there.

  • The customer's executive sponsor holds a written rollout plan with dates and KPIs, and treats it as theirs.

  • Every site that went live did so on terms that make money for Hive.

  • Hive has a documented way of running a global account, in use on the second one.

title: AI Modelling and Simulation Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Lumai is moving from optical-compute research into production AI systems, and the architecture and compiler decisions that shape the product are being made now, ahead of the silicon that will confirm them. This hire builds the modelling capability those decisions rest on.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai's photonic AI hardware performs against real inference workloads, giving the architecture and compiler teams one shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across device configurations. You will model the compute engines, interconnect, memory and bridge interfaces; keep the model honest by characterising operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results; and turn what the model says into decisions teams act on.

What is genuinely hard about this is balancing speed, fidelity and usability. The model has to capture concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency in enough detail to support real architecture decisions, and still compare configurations in minutes rather than overnight. The gap between what the model predicts and what the hardware does has to be measured rather than assumed, and closing it is the part that never stops.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

  • Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations.

  • Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results.

  • Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows.

  • Analyse simulation traces with the architecture and compiler teams to improve layer-to-hardware mappings and resolve performance discrepancies.

  • Run industry benchmarks and representative models - UL Procyon, Geekbench AI, Stable Diffusion and contemporary LLMs - to produce decision-ready KPIs.

  • Develop block-level power models and validate worst-case power scenarios with the micro-architecture, verification and physical-design teams.

  • Own the CI/CD pipelines and simulation flows that keep results reliable and reproducible as usage scales.

  • Translate modelling findings into architecture and compiler decisions, setting technical direction and developing engineers or interns as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Proven experience building or substantially extending a hardware/software performance modelling or simulation framework for AI/ML accelerators, ideally in Python.

  • Strong understanding of hardware concurrency, event-driven modelling and AI inference accelerator micro-architecture: compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect and dataflow.

  • Hands-on experience characterising AI operators and correlating model predictions with real hardware or hardware-accurate reference data.

  • Familiarity with compiler internals and intermediate representations such as MLIR, including tooling that consumes compiler output to drive simulation.

  • Strong software engineering and technical leadership practice: framework design, CI/CD ownership, and direction or review of junior engineers' or interns' work.

Strong preference for

  • Direct experience with NPU, GPU or other edge or client AI inference accelerator architectures.

  • Experience across multiple compiler toolchains, reconciling architecture-level and production compiler behaviour.

  • Exposure to power modelling, RTL, emulation, FPGA prototyping, photonic compute or another non-traditional compute architecture.

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time. Our first optical computing server is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Intelligence
description:
LOCATION: King’s Cross, London · PATTERN: Hybrid, with regular time in the lab

The opportunity

We’re a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You’d help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role builds our analysis from the start. Every result leaves an instrument as a trace or a vendor file, and it has to become a value someone can rely on, linked back to the sequence and sample it came from. That means fitting it properly, checking it against controls, catching the plate or reagent lot that drifted, and showing the evidence. Someone has to own that work. That is this role.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn’t exist yet, so we’re building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We’re in stealth and heads-down on execution. We’ll share more about what we’re building once you’ve spoken with the team.

The role

You will join the intelligence team and own the analysis of our assay data, and the data and ML infrastructure it runs on, from the point the data has been captured to the result that gets delivered. You will work most closely with the protein characterisation scientists who run the assays, and with the software team, who get data out of the instruments and own the platform it lives on. You build on top of that platform, and you own the quality of the analysis that runs on it.

The role is part data engineer and part biostatistician, and all of the data is biological. Much of it is building the analysis and ML pipelines that run on our captured data, and the statistics inside them. The rest is presenting those results clearly, with the statistics that matter, such as uncertainty and QC, shown in a form they can understand. The value is in doing that carefully, in code that behaves the same way on every run.

What you will own

● Analysis and ML pipelines that turn captured assay and sequence data into consistent, versioned datasets, linked to the sequence, sample, plate and well each result came from, built with the software team who own data capture.

● Data validation before any analysis runs, catching a mislabelled plate, a swapped sample or a missing well.

● Sequence-level bioinformatics, such as computing the properties of each protein sequence and checking constructs for problems before the DNA is ordered.

● Biostatistics for experimental data: experimental design, replicates and controls, error propagation, outlier handling, and assay acceptance criteria, such as CV across replicates, Z′ for plate assays, and reference standards staying within range.

● Curve fitting, including dose-response (EC50 and IC50) with sound normalisation and fits to SPR, BLI, HPLC and nanoDSF traces, with a measure of confidence on each fitted parameter and automated QC that sends doubtful fits to a person.

● Detection of plate, lot and batch effects across a dataset before it is delivered, and control charting of reference standards so drift shows up over weeks as well as within a run.

● The data visualisation that accompanies each delivered result, showing it with its uncertainty, QC and batch structure, so anyone can understand and check it without asking us.

Who you are

You have worked with messy experimental data and built things other people relied on. That might have been in a biotech or pharma team, an academic lab, a core facility, or a data-heavy field outside biology where you have since picked up the biology. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

You are happy to get your hands dirty on the data. Much of the job is careful, repeated work on real instrument output, and we want someone who takes pride in doing that well. You write code other people can run, and you care how a result reads to the person receiving it.

Seniority is not what we are screening for. We are open to someone early in their career and to someone with many years behind them. What we look for is depth and judgement on experimental data.

We do not hire people into boxes. This role will stretch past its description, sometimes into the lab and sometimes into conversations beyond the team. Early hires here are expected to pick up what is in front of them.

Must have

● Building and running production data and ML pipelines, ideally on scientific or lab data, including data modelling, validation and reproducible, versioned workflows.

● Handling the specifics of biological data: plate layouts, sample and reagent lot lineage, and protein and DNA construct sequences with the standard tools for working with them.

● Biostatistics for experimental data, including experimental design, replicates and controls, curve fitting, and separating batch effects from biology.

● Statistical process control and anomaly detection, so assay drift and instrument variability are caught early.

● Data visualisation for people outside your team, presenting results with their uncertainty and QC so they can understand and check them themselves.

● Fluency in Python and its scientific stack, including pandas, NumPy and SciPy, and in working with coding agents.

● SQL and relational schema design for samples, plates and results.

● Turning scientists’ questions into requirements, and writing down the assumptions behind them.

Nice to have

● Hands-on analysis of instrument output from a lab, especially trace-based data such as SPR or HPLC.

● R for statistical modelling, such as dose-response fitting or mixed models for plate and batch effects.

● Containers and cloud infrastructure, such as Docker, Kubernetes and AWS.

● Working with data from LIMS, electronic lab notebooks or lab data standards.

● Current protein language models and structure prediction, such as ESM C, Boltz-2, Chai, OpenFold3 or AlphaFold 3.

Why this is unusual

Most assay data analysis happens far from the lab, on files someone exported weeks earlier, with little record of how the experiment ran. Here you sit next to the lab, the conditions of every run are recorded, and your analysis is delivered alongside the data.

The work also changes under you. The lab starts with people running the instruments and becomes automated over time, and the analysis you first build by hand becomes the checks that run on every result.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. It’s worth knowing in advance which one you are.

How we work

The role is based in London, at our lab and office in King’s Cross. Time in person with the scientists matters for this work. The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building.

We work in the open. Decisions are written down and work happens in Slack. The whole company meets once a week at the start of the week, and there is a regular offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late.

UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows.

The team you will join

You will report to the intelligence lead. You will also work closely with the founders and with the protein characterisation scientists whose data you will analyse.

We are a small, elite team, weighted towards science and software. You will be the first person on the intelligence team whose focus is the analysis and ML infrastructure behind our results.

Our process

Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work and what you value, run from the same template for every candidate. A technical stage built on a real analysis problem from our lab, not a puzzle. You spend a few hours writing up how you would approach it, using the tools you would use on the job, coding agents included, with a short note on the decisions you made. We care about judgement more than hours, so a focused answer beats an exhaustive one. We then go through it with you in person. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand.

If you are not sure whether you are a fit, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background.

title: Growth Lead
description:
About Nous

Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a commercially minded Growth Lead to own influencer, one of our core channels and run it as a system rather than a set of relationships.

You'll focus on influencer for your first three to six months, then take on more channels. As we grow, influencer is likely to split into separate areas (micro-influencer volume, macro-influencers, performance, and brand and ambassadors), so there's real room to shape the team.

You'll have run influencer or creator acquisition before, but you'll have approached it as a process and automation problem rather than a partnerships or creative one.

Your goal will be performance, not brand or reach. You'll be hands-on across the channel: finding creators, negotiating fees, writing briefs, reviewing content and managing campaigns. You'll also help answer the bigger questions: who should we work with, what should we pay, what content converts, and how do we scale the channel profitably?

We've built internal tools to manage everything from creator outreach to performance and payments, and we're constantly improving them. You don't need to be an engineer, but your instinct has to be to build it yourself, not to ask an engineer to do it for you.

You'll report to Ezra, our Head of Growth, with support from one to two growth associates.

 

What matters most

We need someone who brings all of these at once:

  • You can own commercial outcomes: what a creator is worth, what to pay, and whether they drove customers at the right CAC.

  • You treat the channel as a process to optimise, scale and automate. You reach for AI tools yourself: you don't have to be an expert, but you're already using them in your own work.

  • You roll up your sleeves. You're urgent and hungry, and you're happy doing hands-on, high-volume work yourself.

 

What you'll do

  • Run influencer campaigns end-to-end: finding creators, outreach, negotiation, briefing, approvals and performance review.

  • Make commercial decisions: work out what creators are worth, negotiate fees and structure deals that make sense for us.

  • Own performance: understand how we're tracking against volume and CAC targets and act when we're falling behind.

  • Build and run high-volume outreach to micro-influencers, alongside managing agency relationships.

  • Create content that converts: write strong briefs and give clear feedback on creator content.

  • Make us more efficient: use AI, internal tools and better processes to reduce manual work as the channel grows.

About you

You'll likely thrive here if:

  • You've run influencer or creator acquisition hands-on, ideally at a startup, and you owned a clear result.

  • You've built or automated part of the channel yourself: sourcing, outreach, negotiation, tracking or payments.

  • You're commercially minded and numerate. You're comfortable negotiating and working with CAC, conversion rates, budgets and targets.

  • You care about performance. You're more interested in whether content drove customers than whether it got lots of views.

  • You have good creative judgement and a strong feel for what works with creators and audiences on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

  • You're happy in a start-up. You're comfortable taking ownership, figuring things out and adapting as the company grows.

This probably isn't for you if you've mostly worked with a large team, agency or engineers doing the hands-on work for you.

title: Product Manager, New Product Bet (Principal-level)
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

Why now

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

The problem you're solving

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

  • Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

  • Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

  • Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

  • Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

  • Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

  • Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

  • Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.

Who you are

You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.

You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.

You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.

You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.

You may be a good fit if you bring

  • Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: setting strategy, not just executing it.

  • A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent.

  • Experience with zero-to-one product development in a complex, experience-driven space. You've navigated the ambiguity of a zero-to-one build and have the scar tissue to show for it.

  • Experience building agentic or AI-powered products. You understand what makes real-time AI interactions feel natural, and what breaks them.

  • Strong written communication: strategy docs, PRDs, and decision memos that others can act on without a follow-up conversation.

  • Experience working alongside enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team, and that context matters.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater - our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

 

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

title: Engineering Internships 2027
description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning

We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill.

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible)

Commitment: Internship-to-hire

What we Offer

  • Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products.

  • Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together.

  • Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter.

  • Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients

  • Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly.

We work across multiple domains:

  • Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX

  • Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs

  • Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems

Your DNA

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field.

  • Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.

  • Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features.

  • Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn.

  • Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow.

Nice-to-Haves (but not required)

  • Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems.

  • Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing.

You’ll see us on campus at:

  • Télécom Paris

  • Forum Trium

  • ENSIMAG

  • CentraleSupélec

  • École Polytechnique

  • EPFL

  • Forum Organisation

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth.
