title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Backend Applications)

We are a global digital innovation agency for the Intelligence Age, specializing in digital product development, brand transformation, media, and communications for major companies. Our Technology team is an integral part of our business; they are perpetual problem solvers, always seeking new and innovative ways to help our creatives bring their ideas to life. We work across a diverse range of projects, from major website builds and core tech platforms to bespoke experiences and strategic innovation with emerging technologies.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a focus on backend applications to be part of our team servicing Google. This role will be responsible for building core services that power major global web experiences, with an emphasis on data ingestion, API design and implementation, and integrations. You’ll be comfortable with a variety of coding languages such as C++ and Python, and will design and scale low-latency RPC/REST microservices, architect globally distributed relational and vector database schemas, build resilient batch data-ingestion pipelines, and own automated CI/CD release workflows from prototype to production.

You will act as a core code contributor within a broader team, moving beyond simple feature implementation to architecting reusable systems, performing rigorous code reviews, and ensuring the seamless integration of diverse technologies. The ideal candidate is a specialist who understands the full software development lifecycle and is passionate about delivering high-quality, production-ready code in a collaborative environment.

Key Responsabilities

On any given day, you will:

  • Design & Evolve API Designs: Design, version, and maintain clean, backward-compatible gRPC and REST/HTTP APIs (supporting multi-version v1/v2 lifecycles), including request/response contracts, deadline budgets, stateless encrypted pagination, and data-governance annotations.
  • Build & Manage High-Performance Serving & Search Features: Build high-concurrency, low-latency backend handlers (using C++ primarily). Optimize hybrid retrieval pipelines that combine full-text search, real-time ML query embeddings, and vector search, with graceful degradation when upstream dependencies degrade.
  • Design Distributed Databases: Architect normalized and interleaved relational schemas, partitioned full-text search indexes, vector indexes, and incremental materialized views on a globally distributed SQL database. Design atomic snapshot/versioning patterns for zero-downtime data updates and instant rollbacks.
  • Manage Scalability & Batch Data Pipelines: Build and operate distributed ETL/batch ingestion pipelines that extract CMS content, perform HTML chunking and rate-limited ML embedding generation, validate data integrity, quarantine malformed records, and bulk-load snapshots at scale.
  • Handle CI/CD, Release Engineering & Observability: Maintain automated build, test, coverage, and progressive rollout pipelines (continuous presubmit, multi-day staging soak phases, and decoupled scheduled data syncs).
  • Collaborate with Frontend Dev & Product Teams: collaborate with other devs to assess product requirements, and translate those into technical specifications.
  • Work with a fullstack team: Collaborate with fullstack web engineers to deliver web experiences leveraging enterprise-grade CMS platforms with custom integrations.
  • Documentation & Technical Mapping: Create documentation to ensure technical clarity, supporting long-term maintenance and team scalability.

The Ideal Candidate

  • T-Shaped: You have deep expertise in system application development, but also possess a breadth of skills to collaborate and contribute effectively across web experiences, a variety of backend stacks, and infrastructure design.
  • Product Mindset: You don’t just build features; you build systems. You are passionate about understanding how the solutions you build serve broader product initiatives and outcomes and use product inputs to inform your architecture approach
  • Large-Scale Delivery: You understand the rigor that needs to go into delivering and maintaining scaled applications and core services for major brands, including release orchestration, working closely with QA to remediate issues, and working in an agile environment with a scaled team.
  • Detail-Oriented Craft: You possess a passion for product quality, ensuring that your code is not only functional but also clean, maintainable, and well-tested; and can work autonomously to hold yourself and your work to a high standard.
  • AI-Enabled: You’re comfortable leveraging AI code-assist tools to accelerate your workflow and are interested in integrating AI services where they add genuine value to work efficiency, productivity, and quality.
  • Always Learning: You proactively keep up with modern best practices and concepts, and constantly look for ways to incorporate new approaches into your daily work.

You Bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building production backend services.
  • Systems Programming: Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20) and familiarity with Python and SQL.
  • API & Service Design: Proven experience designing versioned RPC (gRPC/Protobuf) and RESTful HTTP APIs, including pagination, input validation, error handling, and backward compatibility.
  • Database Design: Solid foundation in relational database modeling, indexing strategies, query optimization, and transaction/consistency models in distributed SQL systems.
  • CI/CD & Testing: Strong grasp of CI/CD concepts—hermetic unit/integration testing, code coverage, automated presubmits, canary deployments, staged rollouts, and rollback strategies.
  • High-Performance Concurrency: Experience with asynchronous/fiber-based concurrency models, parallel fan-out/fan-in execution, tail-latency optimization, and circuit-breaking/fallback patterns.
  • Search & ML Retrieval Systems: Hands-on experience with full-text search engines, dense vector embeddings, approximate/exact vector indexing, or hybrid ranking (e.g., Reciprocal Rank Fusion).
  • Data Pipelines & Streaming/Batch ETL: Experience building large-scale distributed batch pipelines (e.g., Flume, Beam, Spark) with rate-limited external RPC enrichment and dead-letter/quarantine handling.
  • Privacy & Security Engineering: Familiarity with cryptographic token handling (AEAD), strict PII/user-data access controls, automated TTL/wipeout policies, and auditable production data changes.

title: Head of Sales, SMB
description:
About Atomic

Atomic is a venture studio and venture capital firm that builds and scales companies from the ground up. We partner with exceptional founders to launch transformative businesses across industries including AI, fintech, healthcare, consumer, enterprise software, and more. We've launched and scaled more than 20 companies including Hims & Hers, Exowatt, Replicant, Found, Golden Child, and Homebound.

About the Company

An Atomic portfolio company: the all-in-one software platform for an under-penetrated specialty-retail vertical, with point-of-sale, e-commerce, inventory, payments, and compliance in one system of record. 1000+ independent retailers run their stores on it, processing $700M+ in annual card volume. It is part of a permanent-capital software holding company that buys vertical software businesses and rebuilds them as AI-native, backed by Atomic (a $1bn fund and the studio behind Hims & Hers).

About the Role

You are Head of Sales for this company, and you set the sales playbook for the holding company's first acquisition and every one after it. The market already pulls: with no marketing and almost no outbound, stores still sign up every month. You start as a team of one plus a BDR, sell directly from day one, and build the machine the holding company will install at each business it buys.

What You'll Do...

  • Sell, personally: this is not a manage-only seat. You carry your own deals, take the biggest ones, and shape the pitch before the team runs it. Always be closing.

  • Own the whole funnel: inbound, demand gen, and outbound have no owner today; you stand each one up.

  • Build and lead the team: from one to 5-6 in year one; bringing 2-3 AEs you trust is a plus.

  • Help set the number, then own it: no quota in stone yet; you set it with us, then own the forecast.

  • AI-first motion: reps own the conversation and the close; AI does research, follow-up, CRM, and coaching.

  • Write the playbook: the stages, metrics, and weekly cadence the next portfolio company will run.

What You'll Bring...

  • Scaled ARR and a sales team from ~$2-5M to $20-30M in SMB SaaS, ideally at a PE-backed company.

  • You've seen this movie before: you built an SMB sales org from scratch and still love to close.

  • True SMB selling: ~$5-20K ACVs to owner-operators, not enterprise; vertical SaaS, POS, or payments a plus.

  • Strong experience with the phone: you love cold outbound, have mastered closing deals on the phone and scaled it across a team, and still get in the trenches cold calling with them.

  • Operating rigor: a clean CRM, an honest forecast, and comp plans that drive the right behavior.

  • AI-native instincts: you already use AI to make reps faster and want to build a team around it.

  • Extreme ownership: you take full accountability for the team, the number, and the outcomes.

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply.

-----

Please review our CCPA policies here.

What We Offer

title: Onboarding Expert
description:

As an Onboarding Expert, you’ll be a key contributor to an excellent onboarding journey for new and reactivated workers on our app. You’ll guide them, cheer them on, solve blockers, and help them take their first step to making a difference.

  • Host ~5 pre-booked 15-minute onboarding consultations daily.

  • Send follow-up emails and texts to answer questions and support worker onboarding.

  • Respond to inbound messages and support tickets.

  • Keep clear documentation of all interactions.

  • Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement in the worker experience.

  • Be the go-to guide and trusted partner helping professionals feel confident, supported, and ready to work their first shift.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You enjoy talking to people, helping them succeed, solving challenges, and getting them excited about Clipboard.

  • You’re comfortable making calls in a phone-heavy, fast-paced environment and love building rapport quickly.

  • You speak and write English clearly and professionally.

  • You’re organized, follow through on tasks, and don’t let things slip.

  • You’re curious, resourceful, and always looking for the root cause of a problem.

  • You’re quick with tools and not afraid to learn new systems.

  • You’re observant, recognize pain points and opportunities, and aren't afraid to step in and lead the charge on improvements.

  • Able to work weekdays in US Eastern Time.

Experience in inside sales, client onboarding, customer support, or healthcare recruiting is a plus - but not required. If you’re a quick learner with great communication skills, we want to hear from you.

What This Role Is NOT

  • Not cold calling - you’ll only speak with professionals who have accounts on the app.

  • Not technical support - you’ll guide workers but escalate deeper tech issues.

  • Not repetitive - every conversation is unique, and you’ll need to think on your feet.

Why Join Clipboard

  • 100% Remote

  • Mission-driven work that improves lives

  • Supportive, collaborative international team

  • Career growth in a fast-moving tech company

System Requirements

To succeed in this role, you must have:

  • A reliable laptop/desktop (no Chromebooks or Linux OS).

  • Minimum 20 Mbps wired internet connection.

  • Wired headset for clear communication.

  • A quiet, distraction-free workspace.

  • Stable power and internet connectivity.

Ready to empower healthcare professionals from day one?

Start your journey with Clipboard - fill out the form below, and let’s make an impact together.

Want to know more? Please feel free to check out our Remote Work Guidelines.

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

title: Coordinator, Legal Support (Part-Time)
description:

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Coordinator, Legal Support, accountable for providing reliable administrative and general legal support to the Legal team. title: Senior Global Tax Specialist
description:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Team

The Tax team partners across the business to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant tax reporting across our global operations. We play a critical role in managing tax obligations, maintaining controls for tax, and providing insights that inform financial and business decisions. Beyond compliance, we enable innovation by building scalable, efficient processes that support growth, evolving business models, and an increasingly complex global tax environment.

About the role

As a Global Tax Senior based in the Philippines, you will report to the Tax Director and take on a preparer role for tax compliance (income tax and indirect tax), tax provision support, reconciliations, R&D credit study support, and various ad-hoc tax projects.

What you’ll do

  • Prepare corporate income tax, GST/HST, VAT, and sales and use tax return workpapers and supporting documentation.

  • Prepare US indirect tax reconciliations

  • Support preparation of US GAAP quarterly and year end tax provision

  • Prepare Philippines local tax provision and tax return workpapers

  • Support Canadian income tax compliance prepared by external providers.

  • Prepare tax journal entries, reconcile global tax accounts, and maintain quarterly tax account rollforwards and supporting schedules.

  • Prepare transfer pricing workpapers and data collection for studies; support annual tax projects, including R&D credits, taxability refreshes, and nexus reviews.

  • Coordinate tax data collection for close, audits, and filings; maintain documentation and assist with the tax filing calendar.

  • Research and document basic tax questions, monitor relevant tax updates with the Tax Director, and communicate exceptions or changes to stakeholders.

  • Identify recurring inefficiencies and implement small improvements to tax workflows, including appropriate automation opportunities and support for tax tools.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • Ability to work a modified U.S. Monday–Friday schedule, typically aligned to 9 a.m.–5 p.m. U.S. working hours with limited flexibility as needed.

  • A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA or tax-focused advanced degree.

  • 4–7 years of corporate tax experience in a multinational company or public accounting firm (must have multinational/US company experience).

  • Experience with U.S. and Philippine tax compliance, including the ability to prepare and review tax workpapers and assess the reasonableness of tax positions.

  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and IFRS tax accounting concepts, including book-to-tax differences and tax account reconciliations.

title: Senior Tax Manager
description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

As a Senior Tax Manager at Payoneer, you will play a key role in overseeing the company’s global tax compliance and reporting obligations across a multi-jurisdictional environment. You will support Finance, Accounting, Legal, and external advisors by ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant tax reporting. You will act as a strong tax partner, owning tax provision and compliance processes while providing guidance on risk management, planning, and process improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the worldwide income tax provision process (quarterly and annually) in accordance with ASC 740, including ETR analysis, deferred tax calculations, uncertain tax positions, and financial statement disclosures.
  • Maintain controls documentation in compliance with SOX requirements.
  • Partner with Accounting and FP&A teams to understand financial results, forecasts, and key drivers impacting the tax provision.
  • Prepare and review technical tax memoranda related to tax positions and reserves (FIN 48 / FAS 5), including monitoring changes in tax law.
  • Manage the accurate and timely filing of U.S. federal, state, and local income tax returns, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external advisors.
  • Oversee transfer pricing documentation updates and collaborate with internal teams and external advisors.
  • Support Pillar 2 / global minimum tax analysis and implementation.
  • Coordinate Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) requirements with internal stakeholders and external advisors.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams (Finance, Legal) and external advisors on tax compliance and reporting matters.
  • Support local controllers with country-specific income tax compliance as needed.
  • Drive continuous improvement of tax provision and compliance processes, including documentation, templates, and timelines.
  • Mentor and review work prepared by junior team members where applicable.

Who You Are

  • You have 7+ years of progressive tax experience, including public accounting (Big 4 or top national firm) and/or multinational corporate tax.
  • CPA certification is required; MST or equivalent advanced degree is preferred.
  • Strong expertise in ASC 740 tax accounting and U.S. international tax; public company experience is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex processes independently and operate effectively in a multi-workstream environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex tax matters to a range of stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with global finance teams and managing relationships with external advisors.
  • High level of integrity, reliability, and ownership with a strong service-oriented mindset.

What we offer:

  • Discounted medical, dental, and vision insurance (coverage starts on day one) HSA and FSA
  • 401K with employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  • Fitness/Wellness reimbursement
  • Generous PTO, paid holidays, and parental leave
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Flexible work from home schedule
  • Volunteer activities
  • Fun office culture with supportive leadership

Actual annual base salary is based on, but not limited to: experience, education, professional licenses, location and business needs. The position is eligible for health insurance, disability insurance, life insurance, 401k plan, paid-time off, and sick (and where applicable safe) leave. This position is also eligible for a discretionary year-end bonus.

The annual base salary range for this position is

$150,000—$190,000 USD

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

title: Catastrophe Claims Examiner III
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Process insurance claims for property losses based on coverage, appraisal, and verifiable damage. Interact with independent adjusters and policy holders, review claim forms and other records to determine insurance coverage. Make payment recommendations and settlements in accordance with company practices, procedures, and Fair Claims Settlement Practices regulations.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Investigate, evaluate, and resolve claims, applying technical knowledge and human relations skills to promote fair and prompt settlement of claims.
• Adjust reserves and provide reserve recommendations to ensure reserving activities are consistent with company policies.
• Enter claim transactions, in a clear and concise manner.
• Examine claims inspected by independent adjusters, including further investigation of questionable claims, verification of coverage, and timely issuance of payments to policyholders.
• Conduct daily diary reviews on claim files to ensure status letters are sent to policyholders in accordance with Department of Insurance regulations.
• Pay and process claims within designated authority level.
• Supervise independent adjusters to ensure adherence to CFP IA Guidelines.
• Maintain compliance with the Department of Insurance and Company policy and procedures.
• Create correspondence to policyholders that is accurate and complete. Communicate with insureds and/or others involved to secure missing information.
• Promptly negotiate settlements, making sure that the settlement reflects the actual insured losses while ensuring that the insurer is protected from invalid claims.
• Confer with Claims Management and legal counsel on claims involving litigation.
• Requires up to 25% travel, limited to periods of catastrophic events.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
This role may include handling the entire claim (except inspection), or may be responsible for a specific coverage, such as Personal Property or Fair Rental Value. This role will focus on claims over $300,000 in damages, but the Claims Examiner III may receive smaller claims when necessary.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent preferred.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Working experience with MS-Office (especially Word and Excel) is required.
• Certified in CEA and Fair Claims Settlement Practices.
• 5 years total claims experience, 2 years handling HO claims over $300,000.

• 2 Years Carrier experience required

Salary: $46.15-$51.28

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
UX/UI Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer to create polished, user-centered experiences for Venveo's digital products.

This role combines strong visual design with UX thinking, research, prototyping, and design system work. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into high-quality designs and ensure those designs are implemented accurately.

What You’ll Own

Interface Design

  • Create polished, user-centered UI designs for Venveo's digital products.
  • Translate briefs and wireframes into high-quality, production-ready visuals.
  • Ensure designs align with established design systems and brand standards.

UX Research & Validation

  • Conduct or support user research activities, including usability testing and heuristic reviews.
  • Synthesize research findings to inform design decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the user experience.

Prototyping & Iteration

  • Build interactive prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity.
  • Use prototypes to communicate concepts and gather stakeholder feedback.
  • Iterate quickly toward validated design solutions.

Design System Stewardship

  • Contribute to and maintain Venveo's component library and design system.
  • Ensure consistency across product surfaces.
  • Help reduce design debt over time.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders.
  • Align on requirements and define appropriate scope.
  • Ensure designs are technically feasible and accurately implemented.

Handoff & Developer Support

  • Prepare precise design specifications and assets for engineering handoff.
  • Remain available during development to answer design-related questions.
  • Review implementations and provide feedback on design fidelity.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated professional experience in UX/UI design.
  • Portfolio showing end-to-end product thinking and strong visual craft.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including component creation, auto-layout, prototyping, and design system management.
  • Solid understanding of UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, interaction design, and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams alongside engineers and product managers.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate asynchronously and clearly present design rationale.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership when requirements are incomplete or ambiguous.
  • You ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions explicit, and keep work moving forward.
  • You maintain a high standard for visual quality while remaining open to feedback.
  • You treat critique as useful input and separate feedback on the work from personal judgment.
  • You communicate proactively across time zones and surface blockers early.
  • You balance speed and craft, knowing when to move quickly and when a design decision requires deeper exploration.
  • You keep collaborators informed without needing to be prompted.

What Success Looks Like

  • Digital product interfaces are polished, user-centered, and aligned with established design standards.
  • User flows and interaction patterns are clear and thoughtfully designed.
  • Prototypes effectively communicate concepts and support validation.
  • Design system components remain consistent and well maintained.
  • Engineering teams receive clear, accurate specifications and assets.
  • Implemented designs closely match approved designs.
  • Collaboration remains proactive, clear, and effective across product and engineering teams.

Typical Day

Your day will likely begin with a review of async feedback from Venveo teammates on current design files, responding with annotations or updated iterations in Figma.

Mid-morning may involve a short sync with a product manager or engineer to align on requirements for an upcoming feature. From there, you may move into focused design work, refining user flows, producing high-fidelity screens, or building new components for the design system.

Later in the day, you might hand off a completed specification to the development team, run a quick usability check on a prototype, or review a developer implementation and flag any discrepancies.

The role is predominantly async, so clear written communication in every deliverable matters as much as the designs themselves.

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

title: Strategic Events Manager, APJ
description:
About the Role

Abnormal is growing fast, and the way we show up in the world has to keep pace. Our Strategic Events are where our story stops being a pitch and starts being an experience — where CISOs and practitioners walk in curious and walk out convinced. This role owns event execution and delivery across the APAC Strategic Events program — major third-party events, flagship first-party events, and high-profile executive programs — with support from the wider international team.

As Strategic Events Manager, you'll play a central role in shaping our regional events strategy and decision-making, bringing local expertise on how events should land with a local-first approach, and sharp insight into the must-attend industry events across APAC. You'll operate independently on the day-to-day, while partnering closely with sales leadership, regional revenue marketing, sales engineering, channel team managers, and a wide range of other stakeholders to get there.

We're looking for someone who brings new ideas, critical thinking, and the judgement to drive strategic events that move pipeline forward. You're as comfortable owning execution on the ground as you are shaping the plan behind it, and you bring the same rigour to post-event analysis — turning results into clear, data-backed recommendations that sharpen the program year on year.

This is an individual-contributor role: no direct reports, but full accountability for a regional portfolio, a real budget, and the standards that go with it — the autonomy to run your own show, backed by a team when it matters most. If that sounds like your kind of ownership, we'd love to hear from you!

How You'll Deliver Impact

Project Management, Event Logistics & Vendor Management

  • Manage all event logistics end to end and take full ownership of deadlines, project plans, problem-solving, and stakeholder management and communication.
  • Manage venues, exhibition requirements, staff schedules, booth logistics, catering, AV, shipping, accommodation, signage and meeting-space requirements across multiple regions.
  • Source and manage agencies, venues, production partners and suppliers at regional scale, including contracts and negotiation.
  • Build run-of-shows, timelines and contingency plans across multiple concurrent events and markets.
  • Coordinate invitation strategy, registration, attendee communications and internal promotion so the right people show up, market by market.

Regional Strategy & Portfolio Support

  • Support the APAC strategic event mapping and calendar planning, prioritising investment against pipeline and account-engagement goals.
  • Help decide which events are worth the budget, and advocate for the portfolio with regional and global leadership.
  • Understand target accounts, ICP and GTM priorities for each market, and tailor the regional activation strategy accordingly.

Internal Cross-Functional & Partner/Alliance Collaboration

  • Partner with Regional Revenue Marketing, Sales, SDR/BDR, Customer Marketing, Sales Engineering, Partner/Alliance Marketing and Brand/Creative across regions and time zones.
  • Develop and maintain regional partner and tech-alliance event engagement, including co-sponsored and co-hosted activations — this may include building sponsor prospectuses for hosted events and defining sponsorship packages for our global alliances.
  • Work closely with your Revenue Marketing Manager team to ensure Sales are fully enabled on all event details and what is expected of them.
  • Maintain a strong network of reliable vendors and agencies.

Budget Ownership & ROI Tracking

  • Manage event budgets to ensure we stay within budget while getting the most value for our money.
  • Budget admin, including raising purchase orders, submitting invoices, and updating budget management tools.
  • Negotiate to secure the best rates and contract terms.

On-Site Execution

  • Lead on-site execution for flagship regional events, directing any temporary or contract event staff and troubleshooting in real time.
  • Train other on-site team members, including coordinating and leading staff orientations.
  • Set clear expectations on-site for all teams.

Post-Event Follow-Up & Program Result Accountability

  • Own lead capture, CRM hygiene and pipeline forecasting tied to event performance across the region, and report regional ROI to leadership.
  • Build repeatable regional playbooks and share best practice with peers across the broader Strategic Events team, including other regions such as UK/EMEA.
  • Run post-event retrospectives and apply lessons learned to improve the next event, raising the bar for the regional program as it scales.

What You Bring

  • 4–7 years' experience in B2B strategic events, ideally within technology, SaaS, cybersecurity or enterprise software, with a track record of owning a multi-market portfolio independently. Note: this is not a field marketing role.
  • A demonstrated track record of owning event strategy and budget for multiple regions — not just executing a plan set by someone else.
  • Strong program management chops: able to operate with ambiguity, prioritise ruthlessly, and drive cross-functional work to an outcome without close oversight.
  • Experience managing across multiple time zones.
  • Significant budget, vendor and contract management experience across multiple concurrent markets.
  • Experience partnering with regional Sales leadership to align events to pipeline and account goals.
  • Comfortable presenting regional event results, ROI and forecasts to senior stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel roughly 40–50%, mainly across APAC with some EMEA and AMER travel, including evening/weekend work around live events.

Cybersecurity or enterprise software experience is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is commercial judgement, regional ownership, and exceptional execution.

Preferred

  • Experience with event and marketing technology such as Asana, Allocadia, Coupa, Jifflenow, Cvent, Salesforce, Sigma, Splash, RainFocus, Claude, and Google Suite.
  • An additional regional language (e.g. Mandarin, Japanese, Bahasa).
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) principles and target-account event strategies.
  • Experience mentoring or informally guiding more junior events team members.

The Ideal Candidate

You know a great regional events program isn't a string of individual events — it's a strategy. One that brings a brand to life market by market, earns trust with prospects and customers, arms regional Sales teams, and produces measurable business impact across a diverse set of markets.

You're equally comfortable building a regional budget model in a spreadsheet and solving an on-site problem at 11pm local time, several time zones from home. You're calm under ambiguity, direct when something isn't working, and generous with the teams you work alongside.

Most of all, you care about the craft — and about building something regional teams can rely on, not just the next event on the calendar.

What Success Looks Like

  • The APAC events portfolio is delivered consistently and ties clearly back to pipeline.
  • Regional leadership trusts you with their target accounts and plans around your calendar.
  • The regional budget is managed with discipline and a defensible ROI story

description:
Change Management Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Change Management Director is responsible for developing and leading the organization's change management strategy to ensure successful adoption of business transformation, organizational restructuring, digital initiatives, process improvements, and strategic transformation programmes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide change initiatives involving operating model redesign, technology implementation, regulatory changes, organizational culture, workforce transformation, and business process modernization.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to minimize resistance to change, strengthen organizational readiness, engage stakeholders, and ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable business outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide change management strategies, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate organizational transformation objectives into structured change management plans.
  • Lead change management activities across strategic programmes, projects, and business units.
  • Establish change governance structures, standards, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Advise executive leadership on organizational readiness, change impacts, and adoption strategies.

B. Organizational Transformation & Change Implementation

  • Lead organizational change initiatives involving restructuring, operating model redesign, and business transformation.
  • Assess the impact of strategic changes on employees, processes, systems, and organizational structures.
  • Develop change implementation roadmaps, communication plans, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate change activities across business functions to ensure consistent implementation.
  • Ensure new processes, systems, and organizational structures are effectively embedded into daily operations.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Work closely with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners to build commitment to change.
  • Lead executive communication, employee engagement, and organizational awareness initiatives.
  • Address stakeholder concerns and manage resistance to organizational changes.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to monitor employee sentiment and change readiness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Management

  • Lead change management activities associated with digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and new business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT and technology teams to assess the organizational impact of system implementations.
  • Develop training programmes, user adoption strategies, and technology transition plans.
  • Monitor technology adoption and ensure employees effectively transition to new digital working practices.

E. Culture, People & Workforce Transformation

  • Partner with HR leadership to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to promote cultural transformation, leadership alignment, and employee engagement.
  • Identify capability gaps and develop workforce training and development strategies.
  • Support leadership teams in managing organizational transitions and behavioral changes.
  • Promote a culture of adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify potential risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to minimize disruption.
  • Monitor change adoption, employee engagement, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure change initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Benefits Realization & Performance Monitoring

  • Define change management KPIs and adoption metrics.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of change communication, training, and implementation activities.
  • Measure employee adoption, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness.
  • Evaluate whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for executive leadership and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational transformation, business transformation, or organizational development.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide change initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and benefits realization.
  • Experience managing change associated with digital transformation, technology implementation, restructuring, and operating model redesign.
  • Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Professional certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of enterprise-wide change management strategies.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Effectiveness of change communication and stakeholder engagement.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Reduction in resistance-related delays and implementation risks.
  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Achievement of transformation objectives and expected business benefits.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive feedback.
  • Compliance with change governance and reporting requirements.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Backend-Focused)
description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join one of our high-growth client teams to lead the development of next-generation autonomous systems. This is a backend-heavy fullstack role where you will be responsible for more than just simple prompt engineering. You will be architecting Agentic Workflows—systems that can reason, use tools, and execute complex coding tasks autonomously.

 

The ideal candidate is a language-agnostic engineer who is obsessed with the Claude ecosystem and has hands-on experience building systems where AI agents interact with real-world data and codebases. You will bridge the gap between advanced LLM capabilities and robust, scalable backend production environments.

 

What we are looking for:

 

  • Deep expertise in Agentic Development. You should be comfortable building multi-agent systems, ReAct loops, and self-correcting workflows.
  • Mastery of the Claude 3/3.5 family. You understand how to leverage Claude’s high reasoning capabilities and long context windows for complex logic.
  • Experience building "AI-coding" features—using LLMs to generate, refactor, and test code programmatically within an application.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one major backend language (Python, C#, or JavaScript/Node.js) and the ability to design the infrastructure (APIs, Webhooks, Databases) that supports AI agents.
  • While backend-heavy, you are comfortable building the necessary frontend components (React/Vue) to allow users to interact with AI agents seamlessly.
  • Extensive experience giving LLMs "tools"—designing clean API interfaces that agents can call to perform actions in the physical or digital world.
  • Intermediate-advanced English level.
  • Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Nice-to-Have:

 

  • Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI.
  • Knowledge of Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate) and advanced RAG patterns.
  • Familiarity with LLM Observability tools (LangSmith, Helicone) to debug agentic reasoning chains.
  • Background in Software Engineering Fundamentals: You treat AI code like production code (CI/CD, Unit Testing, Version Control).

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design and deploy autonomous agents that can handle end-to-end tasks, specifically focusing on Claude-based coding agents.
  • Build the scalable "brains" of the application, ensuring that AI reasoning is integrated into the core business logic.

The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form.

Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs.

We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency or a martech company and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process."

On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side end-to-end: prospecting and building your own pipeline, working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn.

You will be responsible for:

  • Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting.

  • Prospect actively: research target accounts, identify decision-makers, and open conversations with agencies and in-house teams that haven’t reached out to us yet.

  • Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies.

  • Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 4 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency, a martech company (e.g. SEO, content, analytics, or marketing automation software), or at a company selling into agencies.

  • Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting.

  • Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs).

  • No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing.

  • Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that.

  • Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools.

  • Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above).

  • Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience.

What we offer:

We build the team around experts and stay out of their way. That starts with the basics:

Compensation: $36,000–45,500/year base (excl. VAT, where applicable), plus a bonus system.

Contract: We work exclusively on B2B (contractor) agreements. This means you’ll need your own registered business (e.g. sole proprietorship / self-employed status in your country) and will invoice us monthly.

We take care of the things that matter outside the work itself - your health, your rest, the setup that lets you work well, and the chance to sharpen your craft. Everything else follows from how we operate: trust over control, outcomes over hours.

Location and Remote Work:

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław, Poland.
